arms.better: tm repeatedly inspected the same prepare_body source and never reached an edit or test; its stop message was transparent about the lack of a patch, but saying to resume the saved session while announcing an automatic retry was confusing. The existing repeated-investigation guard should retain findings and prevent fresh retries from redoing the same exploration, while the user-facing recovery instruction should match whether retry is queued.

OpenCode stated a scoped plan, located the body preparation path, implemented the compatibility fix, and accurately reported the focused regression test passing; it also disclosed that ruff was unavailable. It recovered from two failed attempts at writing the regression test by refining the test double and invoking pytest with PYTHONPATH=src. It could be more efficient by checking the available test dependencies and test-double behavior before the first test run, and by avoiding unnecessary complexity in the regression test.
